worker_judgment_notes: The Batch B scout's claimed source (an ArcGIS FeatureServer at services3.arcgis.com/dty2kHktVXHrqO8i/.../Crime_Incidents) was verified during onboarding to actually be the City of Cleveland, OH open-data crime layer (item owner opendataCLE, orgId dty2kHktVXHrqO8i) -- a misattribution, not a Jacksonville source; it coincidentally had a row count (87,563) close to a plausible Jacksonville figure and Ohio-statute StatDesc values (Aggravated Vehicular Assault, ORC 4511.19 OVI references) were the tell. That source was discarded entirely and not used for anything. The correct JSO source was located via JSO's actual public product: the JSO Transparency Portal (transparency.jaxsheriff.org, launched Aug 2024), whose 'Crime & Traffic Crash Maps' ArcGIS Experience Builder app (item fb4b0415d037410687a2b32a444e6bdf, owner CAU_Admin) embeds a 'NIBRS Incidents Map' web map (item e2294d49b43f4eb694d457600d33c053) whose operational layer resolves to this FeatureServer -- owned by the same CAU_Admin account as the app itself, confirming it is JSO's own hosted layer, not a third-party scrape.
